label: PEBC Instruction Tester (CEM side)
info:
Acts as a CEM: builds a PEBC.Instruction body and POSTs it to a resource manager's REST endpoint:

  POST {cemBaseUrl}/resource_managers/{resourceManagerId}/flex_instructions

This is a standalone testing flow, not part of the node-red-contrib-s2 package. Nothing in it depends on the S2 nodes in this repo - it just fires HTTP requests shaped like a PEBC.Instruction.

Setup:
1. Open the 'Config' change node and fill in:
   - resourceManagerId: the RM's id
   - cemBaseUrl: base URL of the CEM's REST API (no trailing slash)
   - pebcPowerConstraintsId: the id of the PEBC PowerConstraints currently active for that RM
2. Deploy - the 'Configure (once)' inject fires automatically and stores those into flow context.
3. Click one of the preset inject nodes (or add your own with a {"lower_limit":..,"upper_limit":..} JSON payload) to build and send an instruction.

Each instruction's execution_time is computed as the start of the next 15-minute UTC period, and id/message_id/power_envelopes[0].id are fresh random UUIDs on every send.

If pebcPowerConstraintsId changes at runtime in your real setup, replace the static Config rule with a wire from wherever you already learn that id (e.g. the RM's PowerConstraints message) instead of hardcoding it.

name: Config: RM id / CEM base URL / active PowerConstraints id
